f3_program: collection("class.students", "student", "class", source("200 students in a class"))
observe(at("class.students.count", "current"), 200, "count", source("200 students in a class"))
percent_of(at("class.students.blue.count", "current"), at("class.students.count", "current"), 30, source("thirty percent like the color blue"))

difference_relation(at("class.students.not_blue.count", "current"), at("class.students.count", "current"), at("class.students.blue.count", "current"), source("remaining students who don't like the color blue"))
percent_of(at("class.students.red.count", "current"), at("class.students.not_blue.count", "current"), 40, source("40% like the color red"))
difference_relation(at("class.students.yellow.count", "current"), at("class.students.not_blue.count", "current"), at("class.students.red.count", "current"), source("the rest like the color yellow"))
collection("class.students.requested_color_groups", "student_group_count", "class", source("students who like the color yellow and the color blue"))
member("class.students.requested_color_groups", "class.students.yellow.count", source("the rest like the color yellow"))
member("class.students.requested_color_groups", "class.students.blue.count", source("thirty percent like the color blue"))
query("sum", "class.students.requested_color_groups", "current")

assumptions: The nonstandard phrase "three times shorter than" does not uniquely specify a length ratio under F3-v1.

f3_program: collection("freddie.team.members", "person", "freddie.team", source("There are 15 people on the team"))
observe(at("freddie.team.members.count", "current"), 15, "count", source("15 people on the team"))
collection("blanket_drive.blankets", "blanket", "blanket_drive", source("collecting blankets for three days to be donated to the Children Shelter Organization"))
collection("blanket_drive.daily_collection_counts", "blanket_count", "blanket_drive", source("collecting blankets for three days"))
observe(at("blanket_drive.first_day.per_member_blankets.count", "current"), 2, "count", source("each of them gave 2 blankets"))

product_relation(at("blanket_drive.first_day.blankets.count", "current"), at("freddie.team.members.count", "current"), at("blanket_drive.first_day.per_member_blankets.count", "current"), source("On the first day, each of them gave 2 blankets"))

add("first_day_collection", "freddie.team.members", at("blanket_drive.blankets.count", "current"), at("blanket_drive.first_day.blankets.count", "current"), source("On the first day, each of them gave 2 blankets"))
member("blanket_drive.daily_collection_counts", "blanket_drive.first_day.blankets.count", source("On the first day, each of them gave 2 blankets"))
multiple(at("blanket_drive.second_day.blankets.count", "current"), at("blanket_drive.first_day.blankets.count", "current"), 3, source("they tripled the number they collected on the first day"))

add("second_day_collection", "freddie.team", at("blanket_drive.blankets.count", "current"), at("blanket_drive.second_day.blankets.count", "current"), source("On the second day, they tripled the number they collected on the first day by asking door-to-door"))
member("blanket_drive.daily_collection_counts", "blanket_drive.second_day.blankets.count", source("On the second day, they tripled the number they collected on the first day by asking door-to-door"))
observe(at("blanket_drive.last_day.blankets.count", "current"), 22, "count", source("a total of 22 blankets"))

add("last_day_collection", "freddie.team", at("blanket_drive.blankets.count", "current"), at("blanket_drive.last_day.blankets.count", "current"), source("On the last day, they set up boxes at schools and got a total of 22 blankets"))
member("blanket_drive.daily_collection_counts", "blanket_drive.last_day.blankets.count", source("On the last day, they set up boxes at schools and got a total of 22 blankets"))
query("sum", "blanket_drive.daily_collection_counts", "current")
assumptions: "each of them" is resolved to the 15 people on Freddie's team.
The requested individual-peach count requires the external denomination conversion that one dozen equals twelve, which the source does not state and F3-v1 does not allow inventing.

f3_program: collection("miss_walter.sticker_type_counts", "sticker_count", "miss_walter", source("Miss Walter has 50 gold stickers. She also has twice as many silver stickers as gold stickers, and 20 fewer bronze stickers than silver stickers."))
observe(at("miss_walter.stickers.gold.count", "current"), 50, "count", source("50 gold stickers"))
multiple(at("miss_walter.stickers.silver.count", "current"), at("miss_walter.stickers.gold.count", "current"), 2, source("twice as many silver stickers as gold stickers"))
offset(at("miss_walter.stickers.bronze.count", "current"), at("miss_walter.stickers.silver.count", "current"), -20, "count", source("20 fewer bronze stickers than silver stickers"))
member("miss_walter.sticker_type_counts", "miss_walter.stickers.gold.count", source("50 gold stickers"))
member("miss_walter.sticker_type_counts", "miss_walter.stickers.silver.count", source("silver stickers"))
member("miss_walter.sticker_type_counts", "miss_walter.stickers.bronze.count", source("bronze stickers"))

partition("miss_walter.sticker_type_counts", at("miss_walter.stickers.total.count", "current"), source("Miss Walter has 50 gold stickers. She also has twice as many silver stickers as gold stickers, and 20 fewer bronze stickers than silver stickers."))
collection("miss_walter.students", "student", "miss_walter", source("her 5 students"))
observe(at("miss_walter.students.count", "current"), 5, "count", source("5 students"))

quotient_relation("miss_walter.distribution.stickers_per_student.count", at("miss_walter.stickers.total.count", "current"), at("miss_walter.students.count", "current"), source("give the same number of stickers to each of her 5 students"))
query("value", "miss_walter.distribution.stickers_per_student.count")
assumptions: The gold, silver, and bronze stickers constitute the sticker inventory Miss Walter intends to distribute among all five students.
